title: 903. Partition Array into Disjoint Intervals

examples.explanation: Split into [5,0,3] and [8,6]: the left maximum 5 does not exceed the right minimum 6. No shorter left part works.
Split into [1,1,1,0] and [6,12]: 1 <= 6 holds, and every shorter left part fails.
The first element alone (1) is already no larger than everything after it.

hints: For each split position compare the maximum of the left side with the minimum of the right side.
Precompute prefix maximums left-to-right and suffix minimums right-to-left so every split is checked in O(1).
Return the first (shortest left side) split whose left maximum does not exceed its right minimum.
